note: Edit the words here and run  python pipeline/readme.py  - every README image is rebuilt from this file. Text must fit its box; the build fails and names the box if it doesn't.
tagline: A native PC port for Windows and Linux — rollback netplay, m-ex mods, Lua
social_tagline: A native PC port for Windows and Linux — rollback netplay, m-ex mods, Lua

features.title: Rollback netplay
features.text: Room codes or Random Opponent. Windows and Linux play each other.

features.title: Competitive lobby
features.text: Blind picks, starters and counterpicks, 1-2-1 strikes, bans and rematches.

features.title: HD at any resolution
features.text: Native D3D12 or Vulkan at any render scale, vsync off, ~13 ms input.

features.title: m-ex mod support
features.text: Mod discs and loose mods: fighters, stages, items and music, online too.

features.title: 94 fighter slots
features.text: Room for big m-ex rosters, with their names, emblems and stock icons.

features.title: Lua scripting + kit UI
features.text: Scripts, a console and gd.kit: draw panels in the menus' own style.

features.title: Training on the kit
features.text: Training can run through the new character and stage select screens.

features.title: Launcher, EN / ES
features.text: Windows and Linux. Mods, diagnostics and crash reports, in English and Spanish.

features.title: Slippi replays
features.text: Frame-accurate playback of .slp replays, straight from the game.

features.title: Settings screen
features.text: Video, audio, controls and online options, applied right away.

features.title: UCF + tournament rules
features.text: Universal Controller Fix and tournament rule sets, built in.

features.title: Deterministic engine
features.text: Bit-exact simulation, checked frame by frame with SyncTest.

features.title: Envoy roguelite
features.text: A run of stages with loot and keystones. Solo, co-op or an online set.

features.title: In-game mod browser
features.text: Browse SSBM Nucleus mods in the game and install them from a queue.
